verdict.rationale: Deel's marketing pages say it runs accurate, compliant payroll for employees, contractors and EOR workers across 150+ countries, with 'real-time cost visibility'. That loosely suggests payroll execution and some view of totals. Nothing in the pack documents the actual payroll-run workflow as a single flow. Missing for 10: documented steps for reviewing hours and earnings, a pre-submission preview of payroll totals, a submit/approve action in one end-to-end flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
